description.value: Bombay Kitchen on Denman is an Indian restaurant on the West End's Denman Street, a well-travelled cycling corridor connecting Stanley Park to the rest of Vancouver. The kitchen draws on North Indian traditions with a menu spanning tandoori grills, street-food kathi rolls, and a broad range of curries made with fresh ingredients and house-blend masalas. Online ordering with free delivery is available, and the restaurant also offers full catering for private and corporate events.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 33m; stands (4 spaces) at 33m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 73m; stands (3 spaces) at 77m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 93m. Total: 17 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms name, address, and phone from OSM. The website prominently features online ordering with free delivery, and the catering menu explicitly lists vegetarian/vegan combos and gluten-free naan options. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or most other cycling amenities, so those are null per rules.
concerns: Catering subpage title reads 'Bombay Kitchen & Bar' rather than 'Bombay Kitchen On Denman' — possible alternate branding or a legacy name.
Website copyright footer contains a typo: 'Bomaby Kitchen On Denman' instead of 'Bombay Kitchen On Denman' — minor but worth noting for quality review.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) could be confirmed from the website; a site visit or direct contact would be needed to answer those checklist items.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Indian restaurant on Denman Street, a primary cycling corridor in Vancouver's West End near Stanley Park; offers takeout and a range of vegetarian/vegan/GF options that are valuable to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Catering menu lists a dedicated 'Vegetarian / Vegan' combo featuring veg and paneer curries; gluten-free naans explicitly noted as available; multiple vegetarian dishes on the regular menu (Channa Masala, Paneer Tikka Masala, Chef Special Mix Veg, etc.)
